item: R826 stage 3c: an import bulk-loaded into a fresh segment, deferred indexes and search triggers, sealed once
summary: open_bulk_load makes a segment file with tables, unique indexes and the title index only, and no identity; seal adds the deferred indexes and article search triggers, rebuilds the search index once, writes the identity, reads the file back with every reader check and closes the registry row. A crash before the identity is abandoned by the next settle and never read; a failure removes the load's own file before the registry step. No settle beside a live writer; schema version re-checked per transaction. Measured 2.4x (plaintext) and 5.2x (encrypted) faster than the live writer at 20k articles x 20 mentions. One-process limit added to the stage 4 conditions. Writes stay off.
